extract: Timothy Gabriel Joseph Evans is an American politician, former law enforcement officer, and former U.S. Army officer serving as the U.S. representative for Colorado's 8th congressional district since 2025. A member of the Republican Party, Evans was previously a member of the Colorado House of Representatives from 2023 to 2025.
